rules.title: Hardcoded credentials or secrets
rules.requirement: Secrets, API keys, connection strings, and certificates must be stored in a managed secrets vault (e.g. Key Vault, Secrets Manager) and never embedded in code, config files, or IaC templates.
rules.recommendation: Move all secrets to a managed vault and inject them at runtime via managed identity or a secrets provider.

rules.title: Publicly accessible data store
rules.requirement: Storage accounts, databases, and object stores holding non-public data must not be configured for public/anonymous access.
rules.recommendation: Restrict access with private endpoints/VNet integration and explicit allow-lists; disable anonymous/public access at the resource level.

rules.title: Encryption disabled or unspecified for data at rest
rules.requirement: All data stores handling business or customer data must have encryption at rest enabled using platform-managed or customer-managed keys.
triggers: encryption at rest is not configured
rules.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest; use customer-managed keys (CMK) for regulated data classes.

rules.title: Traffic not encrypted in transit
rules.requirement: All service-to-service and client-to-service traffic must use TLS 1.2+. Plaintext HTTP or unencrypted protocols are not permitted for production workloads.
rules.recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ everywhere; redirect HTTP to HTTPS and disable legacy protocols.

rules.title: Administrative access without MFA
rules.requirement: Break-glass and administrative access paths must require multi-factor authentication unless a documented, approved exception exists.
rules.recommendation: Require MFA for all administrative and break-glass paths, or attach an approved compensating-control exception.

rules.title: Identity and access model not described
rules.requirement: Every submission must describe the identity provider, authentication method, and authorization/role model used by the workload.
rules.recommendation: Document the identity provider, auth flow, and role/permission model (e.g. RBAC via Entra ID / IAM).

rules.title: Network segmentation not described
rules.requirement: Architectures must describe network boundaries (VPC/VNet, subnets, security groups/NSGs, firewall) separating tiers and trust zones.
rules.recommendation: Add a network diagram or description showing segmentation between public, application, and data tiers.

rules.title: Overly permissive access control
rules.requirement: Wildcard or account-wide administrative grants (e.g. '*' permissions, owner-for-everyone) are not permitted; access must follow least privilege.
rules.recommendation: Scope permissions to least privilege with role-specific grants instead of broad/wildcard access.

rules.title: Single point of failure in production topology
rules.requirement: Production workloads must not depend on a single instance, single availability zone, or single region without redundancy.
rules.recommendation: Deploy across multiple availability zones (and regions for tier-1 workloads) with automated failover.

rules.title: Disaster recovery objectives not defined
rules.requirement: Every production architecture must state a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO).
rules.recommendation: Define explicit RTO/RPO targets and the backup/replication strategy that meets them.

rules.title: No backup strategy described
rules.requirement: Stateful components must document a backup strategy including frequency and retention.
rules.recommendation: Document backup frequency, retention, and restore testing cadence for all stateful stores.

rules.title: No health checks or auto-healing configured
rules.requirement: Compute resources behind a load balancer or orchestrator should use health probes and auto-restart/auto-scale policies unless an exception is approved.
rules.recommendation: Add liveness/readiness probes and auto-healing/auto-scaling policies, or attach an approved exception.

rules.title: Stateful data held only in ephemeral/local storage
rules.requirement: Business-critical state must not be persisted solely on local/ephemeral disk that does not survive instance replacement.
rules.recommendation: Persist critical state in a managed, replicated data store rather than local/ephemeral disk.

rules.title: Cost/budget controls not mentioned
rules.requirement: Submissions must describe cost controls: budgets, alerts, tagging for chargeback, or reserved/committed capacity where applicable.
rules.recommendation: Add budget alerts and cost-allocation tags; evaluate reserved/committed pricing for steady-state workloads.

rules.title: Always-on premium/oversized resources for variable load
rules.requirement: Variable-load workloads should use autoscaling or serverless/consumption pricing rather than fixed always-on premium capacity, unless justified.
rules.recommendation: Right-size and enable autoscaling, or attach a documented capacity/cost justification.

rules.title: Environment lifecycle / decommission plan missing
rules.requirement: Non-production environments must describe an auto-shutdown or decommission policy to avoid idle spend.
rules.recommendation: Add scheduled shutdown/TTL policies for dev/test environments.

rules.title: Observability (logging, metrics, tracing) not described
rules.requirement: Every production workload must describe centralized logging, metrics, and alerting; distributed systems should also describe tracing.
rules.recommendation: Add centralized logging/metrics/alerting (and tracing for distributed systems) with a named tool/platform.

rules.title: Deployment / CI-CD strategy not described
rules.requirement: Submissions must describe how the workload is deployed (pipeline, IaC, environments, rollback strategy).
rules.recommendation: Document the deployment pipeline, IaC tooling, and rollback strategy (e.g. blue/green or canary).

rules.title: Manual production changes outside pipeline
rules.requirement: Production changes made directly through the console/portal outside of the deployment pipeline are not permitted.
rules.recommendation: Route all production changes through the pipeline with code review and audit trail; no direct console edits.

rules.title: Incident response / on-call ownership not described
rules.requirement: Production workloads must name an owning team and describe the on-call/incident response process.
rules.recommendation: Name the owning team, on-call rotation, and link the runbook/escalation path.

rules.title: Performance/scale targets not defined
rules.requirement: Submissions must state expected load (RPS/TPS, concurrent users, data volume) and latency targets.
rules.recommendation: Define expected throughput, concurrency, and latency SLOs (e.g. p95/p99 targets).

rules.title: Caching strategy not addressed
rules.requirement: Read-heavy or latency-sensitive workloads should describe a caching strategy (CDN, in-memory cache, or application cache).
rules.recommendation: Evaluate and document a caching layer (CDN and/or in-memory cache) for read-heavy paths.

rules.title: Synchronous chained calls across many services
rules.requirement: Long synchronous call chains across multiple services should be decoupled with async messaging/eventing unless justified.
rules.recommendation: Introduce async messaging/eventing to decouple the chain, or document why synchronous coupling is required.

rules.title: Data classification not stated
rules.requirement: Submissions must state the data classification (e.g. public, internal, confidential, restricted) handled by the workload.
rules.recommendation: State the data classification and handle it per the corresponding enterprise data-handling standard.

rules.title: Deployment to a non-approved region
rules.requirement: Workloads must be deployed only to enterprise-approved regions per data residency policy.
rules.recommendation: Deploy only to approved regions, or obtain a data-residency exception before proceeding.

rules.title: Resource tagging / ownership metadata missing
rules.requirement: All resources must be tagged with owner, cost center, and environment per enterprise tagging standard.
rules.recommendation: Apply the enterprise tagging standard (owner, cost center, environment) to all resources.

rules.title: Use of non-approved or shadow IT service
rules.requirement: Only services on the enterprise-approved service catalog may be used for production workloads.
rules.recommendation: Replace with an approved service catalog entry, or submit an exception request through architecture review.

rules.title: Compliance/regulatory scope not addressed
rules.requirement: Submissions must state applicable compliance frameworks (e.g. SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR) or explicitly state none apply.
rules.recommendation: State applicable compliance frameworks and how the design satisfies their controls.
